audit_items.proof_trace: The function opens with an early-return guard at L132-135: `if (last_updated == now) { return }`. After the first successful call with timestamp `t`, `borrow_index.set_value(..., t)` (L148) sets `borrow_index.last_updated = t` (borrow_index.move:28). Any subsequent call with the same `t` immediately hits this guard and returns with no state mutation, satisfying the idempotency invariant.
